before: warning signals a condition but normally allows evaluation to continue. withCallingHandlers runs a matching handler in the signaling context. This differs from tryCatch’s exiting handler, which abandons that expression’s remaining normal path.

invokeRestart("muffleWarning") invokes the restart provided by warning to suppress its default reporting after the handler has recorded it. This is not blanket suppression of all failures. The returned result still comes from the code after warning.
